purpose: Design contract for parallel agents: return results via return value, never via shared files or intermediate files, so write race conditions cannot occur.

Scope: covers result handoff to the orchestrator, not write-type agents editing their own scope
Basic principle: agents return results as return values, orchestrator holds them in main context
Collector agents never write artifacts; orchestrator writes once after all complete
No intermediate files or session directories for result handoff
Agent and orchestrator responsibility tables including partial failure handling
Application example: reverse-engineering code collection agent
Anti-patterns: shared file writes, read-modify-write, file locks, intermediate files
